**Clarifying the box in Thirteen Reasons Why**

The user asked about "who has the box" in the series Thirteen Reasons Why. I think they might be referring to the box containing the cassette tapes. In the Netflix series, Hannah Baker left the tapes in a shoebox labeled "13 Reasons Why," which eventually ended up with Clay. At the end of Season 1, there's also another box containing reports, so I should clarify which box the user means.**Clarifying the box in Thirteen Reasons Why**

After Hannah's death, the tapes go public. In Season 2, there's also a separate box of evidence related to Tyler. To be helpful, I should ask the user which box they mean, offering possibilities like Hannah's shoebox or others. I'll clarify!
